History
Reading Plastic Machining & Fabrication (often referred to as RAM) is a Pennsylvania-based precision manufacturing company specializing in advanced plastic machining, metal machining, die stamping, fabrication, and OEM replacement parts. The company traces its roots back to 1950 and has evolved from a small local plastics operation serving Reading's textile industry into a nationally recognized supplier of precision-engineered components for aerospace, medical, military, oil & gas, telecommunications, semiconductor, and industrial applications.
Operations/Products:
Reading Plastic Machining & Fabrication (RAM) is a precision machining and fabrication manufacturer with approximately $15 million in annual sales, serving telecommunications, aerospace, defense, electronics, food, and medical device markets. Operations are primarily focused on producing non-critical component parts to customer specifications, with no design responsibility assumed. The company reports a long operating history with no significant product liability issues and limited subcontracted operations.

Opportunity
This account represents a strong opportunity for a carrier seeking a long-term manufacturing relationship. RAM has been insured with Sentry Insurance for more than 15 years, but management indicated the relationship has gradually deteriorated. Much of the dissatisfaction stems from prior claims-handling experiences and a preference to move away from a direct carrier relationship.
The insured is specifically seeking a broker-centric approach where an experienced intermediary can serve as an advocate and liaison between the company and the insurance marketplace. Their primary objective is not to secure the lowest premium available; rather, they are focused on obtaining comprehensive coverage, strong claims support, and a long-term risk management partnership.
From an underwriting standpoint, this creates a favorable opportunity to lead with coverage, service, and relationship value rather than compete solely on price. The insured appears willing to pay a fair premium in exchange for confidence that their operations, products, and future growth are properly protected.
